description:
Export search analytics data to a CSV file on the machine running this server. Pages through results internally (25K rows per API call, up to 40 calls) to write the full dataset, bypassing the tool response row cap.

Note: Google itself caps how many rows it exposes per day and search type (sorted by clicks), so very large sites may not get the complete long tail. Use dimension_filters to split the export into smaller slices if needed.

dimensions.description: Dimensions to include in the export

site_url.description: GSC property URL. Defaults to GOOGLE_GSC_PROPERTY env var.

name: export_csv
